name: Pekat Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pekat Group Berhad 的间接持股60%子公司 EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd. 以约 RM30.58 million 收购了位于 Negeri Sembilan、Seremban、Mukim Labu 的六块永久工业用地，总面积 38,108 平方米，用于制造与工程业务。同时，集团将已停业的间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd.（原从事电气产品分销）进行成员自愿清盘。此外，Pekat Teknologi Sdn. Bhd.
overview_en: In 2026, EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd., an indirect 60%-owned subsidiary of Pekat Group Berhad, acquired six freehold industrial land parcels in Mukim Labu, Seremban, Negeri Sembilan, with a total area of 38,108 square metres for approximately RM30.58 million, for its manufacturing and engineering operations. Meanwhile, the group commenced a member's voluntary winding-up of E & LP Engineering Sdn.

segments.name: 制造与工程
segments.note: 年内通过间接持股60%的子公司 EPE Switchgear 收购工业用地，用于制造与工程相关活动。
segments.note_en: During the year, indirect 60%-owned subsidiary EPE Switchgear acquired industrial land for manufacturing and engineering-related activities.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接持股60%的子公司 EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd. 以总净购买价 RM30,575,955.32 向 Sime Darby Property (Nilai) Sdn. Bhd.
actions.text_en: EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd., an indirect 60%-owned subsidiary, acquired six contiguous freehold industrial land parcels with a total area of 38,108 square metres in Mukim Labu, Daerah Seremban, Negeri Sembilan, from Sime Darby Property (Nilai) Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 电气产品分销
segments.note: 原从事电气产品分销的间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering 已于2023年停止运营，年内进行成员自愿清盘。

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd.（原从事电气产品及配件分销，已于2023年停止运营）于2026年2月27日股东特别大会决议进行成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd., an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary formerly engaged in distribution of electrical products and accessories that ceased operations in 2023, was resolved at an extraordinary general meeting on 27 February 2026 to be wound up by way…

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 全资子公司 Pekat Teknologi 与 Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia 的谅解备忘录在年内多次更新中均无重大进展。
segments.note_en: The memorandum of understanding between wholly-owned subsidiary Pekat Teknologi and Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia showed no material development in the updates announced during the year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 上述谅解备忘录截至2026年8月19日仍无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The said memorandum of understanding continued to show no material development as at 19 August 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 上述谅解备忘录截至2026年5月21日仍无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The said memorandum of understanding continued to show no material development as at 21 May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Pekat Teknologi Sdn. Bhd. 与 Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia 的谅解备忘录截至2026年2月27日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There was no material development as at 27 February 2026 pertaining to the memorandum of understanding between wholly-owned subsidiary Pekat Teknologi Sdn. Bhd. and Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd.（原电气产品分销业务，2023年起休眠）进行成员自愿清盘，集团不再保留该分销实体。
model_changes.text_en: E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd., an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary in electrical products distribution that has been dormant since 2023, was placed under member's voluntary winding-up, and the group no longer retains this distribution entity.
